title: Scoped negative theorem: three coordinate swaps need nine calls with arbitrary dirty workspace
body:
Three coordinate-SWAP targets require exactly nine paid coordinate-CNOT calls in the formal `F2[GL_2(F2)]` rank-one-idempotent register model, even with arbitrary free scalar mixing and any finite restored dirty workspace. This extends commdata2338's #1491 exactly-three-register certificate; no physical supplier or new kappa is claimed.

The new written lemma compresses a q-call word for t swaps to at most q−t roles. For three swaps, rank and sign parity leave only seven-call improvements; they compress to four registers. Normalizing the three image vectors of the smaller label class gives exactly 35 patterns. All have committed CNF/DRUP certificates, checked clause by clause by two standard-library implementations. An explicit nine-call word attains the entire arbitrary-dirty boundary without extra roles or omitted restoration.

Validation:

- Rebuild all 35 CNFs: 161,432 clauses; check all 3,836 proof additions with both watched and separate scanning unit propagation.
- Independent regular-representation witness checks: 72 full dirty columns; explicit nine-call satisfying CNF assignment; exact gadget, propagation and invalid-proof controls.
- A separate Boolean right-product Z3 encoding returns UNSAT for all 35 cases without timeout. The committed proofs supply the finite premise independently of that solver run.
- Registered replay, provenance pins, selected-record integrity and diff checks pass. Full selected cold replay and repository-wide artifact regeneration were not run for this isolated proof package.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/three-swap-compression-seed6
```

Expected: both proof-checker PASS messages and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`. Optional pinned proof-generation dependencies and commands are documented; the certificate replay needs no SAT solver.

Base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`; OS assignment seed 6, bit-supplier track. Credit commdata2338's #1414 (`9e1640094f649ba6db9742796825a8d6c238989b`) and #1491 (`69638b36c691d3e1b8463526fd68c849e8d1aef9`) for the model, earlier results and questions; Gareth Davidson's #1333 and Ali Romman's abelian obstruction are credited in the package. No predecessor executable implementation or finite enumeration is imported.

The lower bound is a scoped computer-assisted theorem: its arbitrary-register step is a written proof, not Lean or human verified. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged; physical compiler, common-label, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain separate. Four or more targets remain open. Prepared by Cinna Davis (`1337isnot1337`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Claim: Discussion #1514.
